SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmark b JOIN class c ON b.class_code = c.class_code JOIN category cat ON c.category_code = cat.category_code LEFT JOIN category pcat ON cat.parents_category = pcat.category_code WHERE b.member_code = TO_NUMBER(#{memberCode})
AND (cat.name = #{rDTO.filed} OR pcat.name = #{rDTO.filed})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookmark (bookmark_code, member_code, class_code, bookmark_date) VALUES (seq_bookmark_code.NEXTVAL, TO_NUMBER(#{memberCode}), TO_NUMBER(#{classCode}), SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bookmark WHERE member_code = TO_NUMBER(#{memberCode}) AND class_code = TO_NUMBER(#{classCode})
mapper.select: select count(*) from bookmark where member_code=#{memberCode} and class_code=#{classCode}

SELECT DISTINCT p.CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, p.NAME AS categoryName FROM BOOKMARK b JOIN CLASS c ON b.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE JOIN CATEGORY child ON c.CATEGORY_CODE = child.CATEGORY_CODE -- PARENTS_CATEGORY가 NULL이면 자기 자신이 부모, 있으면 해당 부모 카테고리 조인 JOIN CATEGORY p ON p.CATEGORY_CODE = NVL(child.PARENTS_CATEGORY, child.CATEGORY_CODE) WHERE b.MEMBER_CODE = #{memberCode} ORDER BY p.CATEGORY_CODE ASC
